text:
elaine: Quick check-in  we need a tiny ops pack for launch posts: focused KW list, JSON-LD for webinar + benchmark articles, internal-link map (seed -> clusters), and redirects for legacy blog slugs. Lock by EOD Tue.
marco: I'll own KW + anchor CSV. Aim: 15 priority queries (features, benchmark comparisons, integration how-tos).
jamal: Drafting schema. Two minimal snippets: Event for webinar and Article for benchmarks. Paste Event in <head> and validate. Example: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
sophia: Redirects: I exported pre-2024 /blog/* to the sheet (drive: https://drive.google.com/xxx). Proposed flow: 302 for test window (7-14d) -> convert to 301 after QA. Scheduling infra window 02:00-04:00 UTC.
elaine: Add column "anchor_rewrite" with unified CTAs: primary = webinar signup, secondary = demo request. Keep top-funnel posts to single CTA.
marco: For internal linking matrix: seed (launch overview) -> clusters = benchmark, integration guide, pricing, migration, case study. Anchors: "benchmark results", "how to integrate", "cost vs performance", "migration guide", "customer story". Max 2 contextual links per cluster. I'll drop CSV with columns: source_url,target_url,anchor_text,reason.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: benchmark-drafts -> 8 images missing alt text; 2 internal links 404. Sheets updated with row refs.
jamal: When adding JSON-LD, run Rich Results Test + Lighthouse. I'll validate once pushed and report issues. Also: add Article.mainEntityOfPage and image object to Article schema for better rich snippets.
sophia: Sample nginx rules for infra in the sheet comments: ```nginx
# temp 302 test
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 redirect;
# promote to 301 after QA window
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 permanent;
```
elaine: Deliverable checklist by EOD Tue:
- marco: KW list + anchor CSV uploaded
- jamal: schema snippets + validation notes
- sophia: redirect sheet + infra ticket + rollout window
- elaine: copy sync + CTA placement (one primary CTA on top-funnel)
marco: ETA 3pm PST :thumbsup:
sophia: ack, will ping infra and include rollout instructions
jamal: ack, will queue validation once schemas are in head
elaine: one small ask: rewrite anchors to favor webinar signup language for promo posts. we'll iterate after 1 week of benchmarks. :rocket:
